Category: Super Luxury
Fabrication: DV29 - 10,000eb - 1 Month
Type: Internal Body Cyberware
Install: Hospital
Humanity Loss: 14 (4d6)
Option Slots: uses 1

Iconic Internal Body Cyberware, taking 1 Internal Body Option Slot. A nanotech synthskin faceplate replaces the user's face and reshapes its structure, tone and texture, bending their neural impulses so their outward manner matches a stored behavioral scan. In play that means any Acting or comparable check to pass as the loaded personality succeeds automatically. Scans are taken with paired Cybereyes or Smart Glasses, watching a target talk and emote for at least 5 minutes; longer and closer study gives a better copy. The user's own imprint is stored on install. With Audiovox, ChemSkin, Techhair and paired Cybereyes also installed, the imprint covers their whole body, though never their size. Premade imprints ride on Memory Chips and load with an Action, staying on the faceplate afterwards; switching between stored imprints takes an Action and then a 30 minute cooldown.

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Super Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Cyberware).
